name: panama-income-tax
description: Use this skill for Panama income tax (Impuesto sobre la Renta, ISR) of individuals, the self-employed and employers withholding on salaries, for tax year 2026, with the company rules an individual client meets. It gives the art. 700 table (0% to USD 11,000, 15% to USD 50,000, USD 5,850 plus 25% above), representation allowances, personal deductions, educational insurance at 2.75%, the 25% company rate, dividend tax (10%, 5%, 20%) and complementary tax, the Aviso de Operacion tax, withholding on payments abroad, filing by 15 March (individuals) and 31 March (companies), estimated tax and DGI penalties. Trigger phrases include ISR Panama, declaracion jurada de rentas, e-Tax 2.0, seguro educativo, renta territorial and Formulario 07.
